svg.title: Tech Stack & Tools
svg.desc: Network & Security: Cisco IOS, Wireshark, Kali Linux, OpenVPN, Cloudflare. Cloud & DevSecOps: AWS, Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, Actions. Observability: Grafana, Loki, Prometheus. Scripting & Data: Python, Bash, PostgreSQL. Systems: Linux, Ubuntu, Windows, VMware. Workflow: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Ollama

text.font-family: Nunito, 'Trebuchet MS', 'Arial Rounded MT Bold', Arial, sans-serif
